confirm.c_deconstruct_building: Take apart {building}? Its materials are left where it stood.
confirm.c_deconstruct_workshop: This workshop has {n} orders. Deconstruct it?
confirm.c_deepsilver: Deepsilver is the finest metal in the world. Taking it wakes the Hollow: creatures will come up through the rock where it was mined. Mine it?
confirm.c_dump_items: Mark {what} for dumping? Dwarves will carry every one of them to a dump zone.
confirm.c_dump_selection: Dump everything on these {n} tiles? Dwarves will carry it to a dump zone.
confirm.c_load_snapshot: Load the {season} snapshot? The current game continues to exist as its own saves.
confirm.c_main_menu: Return to the main menu? Unsaved progress since {time} will be lost.
confirm.c_melt_items: Mark {what} for melting? Melted items are gone; the smelter gives back part of their metal as bars.
confirm.c_quickload: Load the quick save? Unsaved progress will be lost.
confirm.c_release_cage: Release {creature} from {cage}? It is set down beside the cage, as wild or hostile as it was.
confirm.c_remove_order: Remove the order for {recipe}? Work in progress on it stops.
confirm.c_remove_stockpile_items: This stockpile holds {n} items. They will stay where they are. Remove it?
confirm.c_remove_zone_crops: This plot has {n} growing crops. Remove it?
confirm.c_retire: Retire {fortress}? The hall will be recorded in the Legends and cannot be resumed.
confirm.c_slaughter_animal: Slaughter {animal}? It will be butchered for meat, hide and bone.
confirm.c_suspend_workshop: Suspend {workshop}? Its current job stops and its orders wait until you resume it.
confirm.c_tutorial: Is this your first fortress? The tutorial sets up a friendly site and walks you through the basics, a step at a time. Play it?
deep_intro.descent: Somebody always has to go down first.
deep_intro.drink: Nine hundred feet down, he stopped for a drink.
deep_intro.subtitle: a hall beneath the world
hint.hint_alert: Click a door and choose Lock on alert. Then [m] and [3] raise the Hearth alert: civilians go to the hearth and those doors lock, but a dwarf in dire need still goes out to eat, drink or sleep, and the medics still tend the wounded.
hint.hint_barrel: A brew needs an empty barrel, and a barrel that holds food or seed is not empty. Order a barrel at the carpenter's workshop.
hint.hint_cage: Cage traps catch anything smaller than a wyrm. Caged beasts can be tamed at a kennel or sold.
hint.hint_containers: Stockpiles need barrels for drink and bags for seeds. The carpenter makes barrels; the clothier makes bags.
hint.hint_deep: Deepsilver lies beside the Sea of Fire. Taking it wakes the Hollow. The threats panel shows the Deep gauge.
hint.hint_depot: Build a trade depot [b > Special] before the caravan arrives.
hint.hint_dig: Designate a place to dig with [d]. Dwarves dig into rock faces from the side.
hint.hint_farm: Farms need soil, mud left by water, or cave loam.
hint.hint_food: Food is running low. Check the farm plots' crops [z], order meals at a kitchen, and gather plants [d].
hint.hint_fuel: Smelters and forges need fuel. A wood furnace makes charcoal from logs; coal seams burn too.
hint.hint_gate: A drawbridge over a channel is the surest gate. Build a lever inside [b], click it, press [i] and click the bridge; [y] pulls it.
hint.hint_haulers: Items are waiting to be hauled. Enable hauling for more dwarves in the labors panel.
hint.hint_hearth: A hearth makes a hall a home. Build one [b > Special] in your main hall.
hint.hint_hospital: A hospital zone needs a bed, a chest, cloth and thread. Brightleaf treats infection.
hint.hint_hunter: Hunters need a crossbow and bolts, or a bow and arrows.
hint.hint_immigration: Immigrants come at the turn of the season when hall spirit is Content. Good rooms, meals and drink raise it.
hint.hint_magma: A forge over channeled magma needs no fuel. Build it of magma-safe stone.
hint.hint_no_miners: No one has mining enabled. Turn it on in Labors [l].
hint.hint_no_path: Jobs are blocked: no path. Check for doors, water and undug rock.
hint.hint_predator: A beast that hunts dwarves is near. [m] then [3] raises the Hearth alert: civilians go to the hearth and doors set to Lock on alert shut. [n] then [2] shows where it is.
hint.hint_room: A room needs walls or doors around it, a bed, and smooth stone to be worth sleeping in.
hint.hint_seeds: Harvest returns one seed. Brewing and cooking do not.
hint.hint_shelter: Wild beasts will come. Dig a hall into rock, put a door on it, click the door and choose Lock on alert. Make a squad in [m] and arm it with iron spears: clubs lose to boars. Order a kill when a beast comes.
hint.hint_still: Dwarves need drink. Build a still [b > Workshops] and brew from plants.
hint.hint_stockpile: Set up a stockpile [z] so hauled goods have somewhere to go.
hint.hint_troll: Trollkin break doors. Walls and raised bridges hold.
hint.hint_winter: Winter comes in 60 days. Farms need soil or mud; cave crops grow in the dark all year.

tutorial.dig: Open Designate with [d]: Dig is chosen. Go down a level with [<] into the rock, click one corner of a box, then the opposite corner (or Enter twice). The marked tiles blink while the work waits for a miner.
tutorial.farm: Food grows on soil. In Zones ([z]), [S-f] chooses a farm plot: drag it over soil or grass. Click the plot to choose its crop for each season.
tutorial.labors: A dwarf works only at the labors that are on. Open Labors with [l]: ↑↓ choose a dwarf, a click on a cell turns that labor on or off, and [S-a] turns the whole row.
tutorial.look: Look at things with [k], or a click on the map. The look panel's Tile tab lists all that lies on the tile, and the status row names what is under the pointer. Look at a tile, then at one of your dwarves.
tutorial.order: Workshops make what is ordered. Open Orders with [o]: [S-n] adds an order, type part of a recipe's name and press Enter. An order waits for a workshop that can make it.
tutorial.save: Save your fortress: [F5] makes a quick save, and Esc opens the game menu, which has Save. Saves are kept in this browser.
tutorial.speed: Time stands still while the game is paused. [Space] pauses and resumes, and [+] and [-] change the speed. Run the fortress at 2× or 4×, then pause it again.
tutorial.stairs: Stairs lead down. In Designate, [S-j] chooses down stairs: click a floor tile twice. Change the level between the two clicks and the box makes a stair column, down stairs on top and up stairs below.
tutorial.stockpile: Hauled goods need a place. Open Zones with [z], choose a stockpile with [S-s], and drag a rectangle over open floor (or Enter at two corners).
tutorial.view: Welcome to your hall. Move the view with ←→ ↑↓ (or drag with the middle button), and change the level with [<] and [>] (or the wheel). Do both: the z field below shows the level.
tutorial.workshop: Open Build with [b], then [w] for the workshops. Choose one with ↑↓ and Enter, then click a free spot, or Enter at the cursor. Dwarves build it once time runs.
